import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p=Path.cwd();f='src/URMatchingSurvivorMatching.lean';s=(p/f).read_text().replace('    simpa [K, retainedInputs, not_and_or] using hx','    by_cases hl : Sum.inl x.val ∈ D
    · exact Or.inl hl
    · right
      by_contra hr
      exact hx (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,hl,hr⟩)')
s=s.replace('    dsimp [charge] at hv
    split_ifs at hv with hx hy hy
    · exact Sum.inl.inj hv
    · cases hv
    · cases hv
    · exact (σ 0).injective (Sum.inr.inj hv)','    by_cases hx : Sum.inl x.val ∈ D <;> by_cases hy : Sum.inl y.val ∈ D
    · simp only [charge, dif_pos hx, dif_pos hy] at hv
      exact Sum.inl.inj hv
    · simp only [charge, dif_pos hx, dif_neg hy] at hv
      cases hv
    · simp only [charge, dif_neg hx, dif_pos hy] at hv
      cases hv
    · simp only [charge, dif_neg hx, dif_neg hy] at hv
      exact (σ 0).injective (Sum.inr.inj hv)')
s=s.replace('  omega

theorem firstMatching_retained','  change N ≤ K.card + D.card
  omega

theorem firstMatching_retained')
r=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3','-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),f],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);print(r.stdout);assert r.returncode==0
